faqData.question: Can guests take photos during the ceremony?
faqData.answer: We kindly ask guests to refrain from taking photos or videos during the bridal march. Our professional photographers will capture this special moment. Please wait until after the ceremony before sharing on social media. A QR code will be provided for photo sharing.

faqData.question: What is the wedding dress code?
faqData.answer: Formal attire is kindly requested in the color palette provided. To honor the groom & bride, white is reserved exclusively for them. We kindly ask guests to avoid slippers, shorts, jeans, and T-shirts.

faqData.question: Are children allowed at the wedding?
faqData.answer: While we love children, we are only able to accommodate those who are part of the entourage. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation. We also kindly request no plus ones.
